summary: The final wait has a message-boundary mismatch while the hero regains sight inside a harmful gas cloud. C combines sight recovery, eye stinging, and burning-lung messages before its --More-- prompt; JavaScript shows --More-- immediately after sight recovery. The exact source owner is still unresolved: inspect blindness-expiration output, region callback order, and the TTY map-flush/message boundary before selecting a fix.

source.branch: A harmful gas cloud affects the hero and a hostile orc during the same elapsed turn. C allmain.c calls nh_timeout before run_regions; inside_gas_cloud emits hero and monster messages. The first visible divergence is at the transition from blindness-expiration output to gas-cloud output.

evidence: The saved v13 evaluation at 35deeae3b45298577e919836bfad5c2da681ab6b reports 69/70 screens and cursors with all 2940 RNG values matching; first mismatch is segment 0 step 69, screen row 0 column 18 and cursor C [78,0,1] versus JS [26,0,1]. Immutable recording: challenges/cases/v13/hostile-orc-exposed-to-poison-gas.session.json, SHA256 feb5051b45974360d89bb56d7c552f7ccd3ac70dcf901162511a6bdf8daee028.

Read-only replay at 3fdd3c65d0b811b96963e3e87b8ec41d83493e84 confirmed C’s final top line “You can see again.  Your eyes sting.  Something is burning your lungs!--More--” while JS has “You can see again.--More--”. Steps 64-68 match, each showing an unknown-space command; the final input is period. The JS runner emits 70 screens and leaves “You can see again.” as its pending message after input exhaustion.

Upstream allmain.c:273-274 orders nh_timeout before run_regions. region.c:1091-1165 defines inside_gas_cloud; its hero branch prints eye stinging, makes blinded, prints burning lungs, and may wake nearby creatures and damage the hero. JS js/allmain.js:893 and 938 preserves nh_timeout then run_regions; js/region.js:381-466 appears to preserve the hero branch’s message order. The mismatch may be in visibility redraw or the message-window flush between these source calls, but that is not yet proven.

Next probe: trace C potion.c:make_blinded and pline.c/win/tty topline behavior at the sight-recovery turn against js/potion.js:make_blinded and js/tty_message.js:ttyPlineCore/flush_screen. Find the first event that causes JavaScript to display --More-- before region.c’s next message; test a shorter independently recorded C case that isolates blindness expiration with and without an active gas cloud. Do not alter the frozen v13 recording.
